_comment: The SIT seed's catalog (docs/sit-seed.md), read by SeedData. The seed features name each booking by composition (the Excel's Itradeable Type, the E2E's composition) and product ID; this file holds only what a pair needs beyond that. trades: a list of {composition, productId, dat, setup} for a pair whose dat file name or body is not the default (a registered composition's dat is data/dat/<C>/<C>.dat, any other's seed/dat/<C>/<productId>.dat; the body is data/setup/trade-create). variants: another body for a pair, by name. events: the E2E Outline whose positive case's request books the event, via trigger-event (the default) or update (the amendment).
